svg.title: How Aiana answers a question
svg.desc: Animated diagram: the question is embedded with Workers AI, matched against your documents in Vectorize (top 8, score at least 0.35), combined with your records from D1, and sent to Claude through AI Gateway. The answer cites the page it used, shown from R2.
svg.text: One question, five steps, about as long as it takes to read this line. (Demo manual shown.)

g.text: About 4.8 qt with a new filter.

svg.text: Answers cite the page they came from.
Workers AI turns it into 768 numbers
Vectorize: top 8 matches, keep scores ≥ 0.35. Short
follow-ups search with the last question too.
From D1: service history, forecast, NHTSA recalls,
your specs, reminders, the last 4 hours of chat.
Through your AI Gateway to Claude Haiku 5.5, with
tools to add or edit reminders.
The answer lists its sources; thumbnails come from

g.text: used only when you ask for a change
